title: BFLO Harbor Kayak

services.name: Single Kayaks
services.desc: Don’t own your own kayak but still want to have fun? BFLO Harbor Kayak offers hourly rentals of our kayaks for your summertime fun needs! Renting a kayak doesn’t have to be a hassle. With low costs and awesome rates, we won’t break the bank. Children under age 13 must wear a securely fastened life vest while kayaking. All life vests are U.S. Coast Guard approved, in safe and useable condition. We will properly size the person with the appropriate Personal Floatation Device (PFD). We offer flexible option for private events and tours. We will work with you to provide the best experience for your group. We ask that you file out a small form and a representative will follow-up to help you plan

services.name: Sunset River Tour
services.desc: Paddling down the Buffalo River, through the grain silo’s, is a great way to see a piece of Buffalo’s History and paddling back while watching a fabulous summer sunset… that is a magical experience. Our boats are easy to paddle and very stable, making them a great way to get started kayaking with minimal instruction. We use single and tandem kayaks daily from Memorial Day Weekend through Labor Day Weekend. Guides accompany every tour on the river to help you maximize your river experience.
